# JpStudy

JpStudy is a local-first JLPT study app for vocabulary, grammar, kanji, reading practice, and spaced repetition.

- [JpStudy app](https://jpstudy.web.app/)
- [Usage policy](https://jpstudy.web.app/#/usage-policy)
- [Privacy](https://jpstudy.web.app/#/privacy)
- [Terms](https://jpstudy.web.app/#/terms)
